func (SecureStore) Known() bool
type State string
const StateActive

type StoreOutcome uint32
const StoreOutcomeStored
const StoreOutcomeConflict
const StoreOutcomeInvalid
const StoreOutcomeUnsupportedKind
const StoreOutcomeNoSecureStore
const StoreOutcomeExhausted
const StoreOutcomeForbidden
const StoreOutcomeUnavailable
func (StoreOutcome) String() string
func (StoreOutcome) WireName() (string, bool)
func ParseStoreOutcome(word string) (StoreOutcome, bool)
func (StoreOutcome) MarshalText() ([]byte, error)
func (StoreOutcome) UnmarshalText(text []byte) error
func (StoreOutcome) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)
func (StoreOutcome) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error
func StoreOutcomeValues() []StoreOutcome
func (StoreOutcome) Known() bool

type ServiceErrorCode string

var CredentialKinds
var ResourceActions
var ExecutionGuarantees
var Consumers
type Subject struct
  Account string
  Program string
type Scope struct
  Targets []string
  Consumers []string
type Metadata struct
  Name string
  Kind string
  Revision string
  State State
  Scope Scope
  RegisteredBy Subject
  Registered string
  Expires string
  Header string
  LastApplied string
type Registration struct
  Name string
  Kind string
  Scope Scope
  Expires string
  Header string
  Secret []byte
type Rotation struct
  Name string
  Expires string
  Secret []byte
type StoreResult struct
  Outcome StoreOutcome
  Revision string
  Current *Metadata
type RotateResult struct
  Outcome RotateOutcome
  Revision string
  Current *Metadata
type RevokeResult struct
  Outcome RevokeOutcome
  Revision string
type Limits struct
  MaxCredentials int64
  MaxSecretBytes int64
  TombstoneRetentionMs int64
  AuditRetentionMs int64
  AuditCapacity int64
  SecureStore SecureStore
  SupportedKinds []string
type MetadataPage struct
  Outcome PageOutcome
  Limits Limits
  Records []Metadata
  Next string
  Complete bool
type AuditEntry struct
  Sequence int64
  Time string
  Event string
  Name string
  Revision string
  Subject *Subject
  Consumer string
  Target string
  Outcome string
type AuditPage struct
  Outcome PageOutcome
  Entries []AuditEntry
  Next string
  AtEnd bool
type Use struct
  Subject Subject
  Consumer string
  Name string
  Target string
  Challenge string
type CheckResult struct
  Outcome ApplyOutcome
  Revision string
type ApplyResult struct
  Outcome ApplyOutcome
  Revision string
  Headers map[string]string
func Encode(v *Registration) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
func Decode(in []byte) (*Registration, error)
type FrameWriter interface
  WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
type DispatchError string
func (DispatchError) Error() string
func ServiceName(frame []byte) (string, error)
type FrameExchanger interface
  ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type ServiceError struct
  Code ServiceErrorCode
  Message string
func (ServiceError) Error() string
const EndpointContract
type DescribedService interface
  DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func DescribeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...DescribedService) ([]byte, error)
type ServedService interface
  DescribedService
  ServiceContract() string
func ServeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
type Holder interface
  Store(expectedRevision string, registration Registration) (StoreResult, error)
  Rotate(expectedRevision string, rotation Rotation) (RotateResult, error)
  Revoke(expectedRevision, name string) (RevokeResult, error)
  List(cursor string, limit int64) (MetadataPage, error)
  Audit(cursor string, maxEntries int64) (AuditPage, error)
type HolderTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type HolderClient struct
func NewHolderClient(t HolderTransport) *HolderClient
type HolderDispatcher struct
  Handler Holder
func (HolderClient) Store(expectedRevision string, registration Registration) (result StoreResult, err error)
func (HolderClient) Rotate(expectedRevision string, rotation Rotation) (result RotateResult, err error)
func (HolderClient) Revoke(expectedRevision, name string) (result RevokeResult, err error)
func (HolderClient) List(cursor string, limit int64) (result MetadataPage, err error)
func (HolderClient) Audit(cursor string, maxEntries int64) (result AuditPage, err error)
func (HolderDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (HolderDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (HolderDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (HolderDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type Applier interface
  Check(usage Use) (CheckResult, error)
  Apply(usage Use) (ApplyResult, error)
type ApplierTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type ApplierClient struct
func NewApplierClient(t ApplierTransport) *ApplierClient
type ApplierDispatcher struct
  Handler Applier
func (ApplierClient) Check(usage Use) (result CheckResult, err error)
func (ApplierClient) Apply(usage Use) (result ApplyResult, err error)
func (ApplierDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (ApplierDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (ApplierDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (ApplierDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
